questions.question: In high-frequency recombination (Hfr) bacterial conjugation involving the F-factor (fertility plasmid), what determines the specific sequence and starting point of chromosomal gene transfer into the recipient cell?
options: The location and integration orientation of the F plasmid within the donor chromosome
The concentration of extracellular divalent calcium ions regulating sex pilus retraction
The thickness of the peptidoglycan layer in the recipient bacterial cell wall
The random cleavage site produced by host restriction endonucleases prior to transfer

questions.question: Cholera toxin alters cell signaling via G-protein coupled receptor (GPCR) pathways. What is the direct biochemical mechanism of this toxin, and what is its ultimate physiological effect on intestinal epithelial cells?
options: It promotes rapid degradation of protein kinase A, causing uninhibited opening of basolateral potassium channels.
It prevents GDP-GTP exchange on the G-alpha-s subunit, suppressing adenylyl cyclase activity.
It ADP-ribosylates the G-alpha-s subunit to inhibit its GTPase activity, leading to constitutive adenylyl cyclase activation and lumenal chloride secretion.
It dephosphorylates the G-beta-gamma complex, causing hyperactivation of phospholipase C.

questions.question: In developmental biology, what primary phenotypic defect occurs when a loss-of-function mutation inactivates a specific Homeobox (Hox) gene during embryogenesis in Drosophila melanogaster?
options: Entire body segments fail to form, producing a severely truncated embryo.
Dorsal-ventral polarity is inverted, positioning neural structures on the dorsal side.
Programmed cell death is globally inhibited, yielding duplicated limbs across all segments.
Affected body segments undergo homeotic transformation, taking on the structural identity of adjacent segments.

questions.question: During B cell development, Immunoglobulin class (isotype) switching requires the enzyme activation-induced cytidine deaminase (AID). What specific molecular modification is directly initiated by AID at switch (S) regions of the heavy chain locus?
options: Generation of double-strand DNA breaks directly through intrinsic endonuclease activity
Deamination of cytosine residues to uracil in single-stranded DNA DNA target sites
Addition of non-templated N-nucleotides to blunted DNA ends
Covalent ligation of light chain variable regions to heavy chain constant regions

questions.question: During juxtacrine signaling via the canonical Notch pathway, what biochemical event immediately follows the binding of the membrane-bound Delta ligand on a signaling cell to the Notch receptor on an adjacent target cell?
options: Trans-autophosphorylation of the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain on Notch
Sequential proteolytic cleavages that release the Notch intracellular domain (NICD) to translocate to the nucleus
Opening of the Notch receptor ion pore, triggering an influx of extracellular calcium ions
Binding of GTP to the intracellular domain of Notch, initiating a cytosolic cascade
